name: Anlon Technology Solutions Ltd.
summary: Anlon Technology Solutions Ltd. is an engineering services provider that specializes in advanced firefighting, rescue, and infrastructure solutions. The company operates on a service-led business model, partnering with global original equipment manufacturers for the distribution, installation, and maintenance of specialized machinery. Its primary offerings include mobile firefighting and rescue units, disabled aircraft recovery kits, and runway safety and maintenance solutions such as rubber removal machines, sweeping machines, and friction testers. Anlon also provides airport ground support equipment, airport interior components, industrial fire engines, high-rise building firefighting equipment, power transmission systems, and climate control systems for various vehicles. The company delivers comprehensive technical services, including engineering consultancy, training, and after-sales support through long-term maintenance contracts and spare parts distribution. Anlon Technology Solutions Ltd. primarily serves airports, fire stations, multinational corporations, critical infrastructure sectors, high-rise buildings, refineries, and municipalities. It operates across India and has an international presence in Asia, the Middle East, and Africa through distribution partners, focusing on the aviation safety, rescue, and infrastructure industry, and operating within the Aerospace & Defense sector.
